title: Spicy Pasta Fiesta
description: A Mexican-inspired spicy pasta dish that combines the flavors of the Aji pepper with the crunch of crunchy elements. This recipe is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the Aji pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the umami sauce over medium heat.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add the diced tomatoes, ground cumin, chili powder, and salt to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce.
Top the pasta with crunchy elements and fresh cilantro.
Optional: Add diced jalapeños or hot sauce for an extra kick of heat.
